# Build on Verana

Guides organised by what you want to do. Each guide names the surface it uses (the Frontend, the VS Agent Admin API, the MCP server, the command line), its prerequisites, and how to verify the result on testnet.

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| Make a service or an AI agent verifiable and trusted, join ecosystems, issue and verify credentials | [Verifiable Services with VS Agent](./verifiable-services/index.md) |
| Create an ecosystem, define schemas, accredit issuers and verifiers, run a business model | [Ecosystems with the Frontend](./ecosystems/index.md) |
| Add Verana trust to a personal wallet and get it listed | [Personal wallets](./personal-wallets/index.md) |
| Connect an AI agent or an MCP client to the network | [AI agents and MCP](./ai-agents-mcp/index.md) |
| Run a node, an indexer, the graph, the frontend | [Run the infrastructure](./run-infrastructure/index.md) |
